- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Traditional dishes from the coastal region of Croatia include: 
  1. Pasticada - a slow-cooked beef dish served with gnocchi

  7. Fuzi with truffles - homemade pasta served with a truffle cream sauce
  8. Gradela - grilled sardines
  9. Peka - a baked dish with meat or fish, potatoes, and vegetables, traditionally cooked in a bell-shaped lid over hot coals
  10. Dubrovnik Rozata - a dessert similar to crème brûlée.

- [USER] User is intrigued by the black risotto dish and requests more information about it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Black risotto, also known as crni rižot in Croatian, is a traditional seafood dish popular in Istria and Dalmatia. It is unique due to its black color from squid ink.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for black risotto typically include squid, mussels, clams, garlic, onions, white wine, and arborio rice, cooked in fish stock with squid ink.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Black risotto is often served as a main course or appetizer, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon juice.
